about.name: Frederico Huertas
about.title: Frontend Developer
about.summary: Career-changing web developer with hands-on experience building React frontends and custom WordPress solutions. After more than a decade in logistics and operations, I transitioned into web development through self-directed learning and volunteer work, contributing to live websites for charities and community organisations. Particularly interested in the intersection of React, WordPress, and headless CMS architecture.

experience.summary: Manages and publishes content on a live WordPress/Divi website for a registered Irish charity, contributing to content updates and SEO improvements.
highlights: Publishes and maintains content on a live production WordPress/Divi website.
Creates SEO-optimised blog posts using Yoast SEO, including focus keyphrases, meta descriptions, slugs and excerpts.
Updates patient stories, hero images, page titles and permalinks while following production best practices.
Works with sensitive health-related content and collaborates with the charity's founder on content planning and publishing.

experience.summary: Builds and customises WordPress themes using PHP while collaborating with a senior developer in an agency-style workflow.
highlights: Builds and customises WordPress themes using PHP and the WordPress template hierarchy.
Develops dynamic, responsive event and content templates.
Migrated a drag-and-drop event gallery from jQuery to vanilla JavaScript using SortableJS.
Diagnosed and resolved PHP meta box callback issues during development.
Maintains local development environments with Docker and Local by Flywheel.
Uses Git and GitHub for version control and team collaboration.

projects.title: DriveFlow
projects.summary: Headless WordPress and React garage management platform built for a Japanese-owned garage in Dublin. Combines a custom WordPress backend with a React frontend, focusing on REST API integration, custom post types, authentication, and modern frontend development.

projects.title: Wolfgang Digital Awards Page
projects.summary: Frontend recreation of Wolfgang Digital's awards page built as part of a junior web developer technical test. Focused on responsive design, animations, UI accuracy, and presenting technical work during an interview.

projects.title: HHT Ireland
projects.summary: Volunteer Web Content Editor role maintaining a live WordPress website for an Irish charity. Involves content publishing, SEO improvements, page updates, and working collaboratively with the organisation.

projects.title: Greenhouse Culture
projects.summary: Volunteer Web Developer role working with WordPress, PHP, and website improvements alongside an experienced engineering team. Focused on theme customisation, frontend improvements, plugins, and collaborative development workflows.

projects.title: Zenscape
projects.summary: Japanese garden themed website built to practice modern frontend development, focusing on clean UI/UX, animations, and reusable component architecture.

projects.title: Lek's Bakehouse
projects.summary: Single-page website created for a friend's dessert business, showcasing artistic desserts through a clean, responsive design with modern frontend techniques.
